item.description: - Performance shows live CPU, memory, storage, and battery cards and splits into Summary, Apps, Startup, and Maintenance tabs - Quick Look previews files from My Clutter and Space Lens: click a file, press Space, or click its bar in Space Lens - Space Lens selects items with checkboxes, and clicking a row opens the folder or previews the file - The main window stays between 1000×680 and 1600×1100
